stories.title: Ohio State replaces BYU at No. 2 in AP Top 25
stories.summary: No. 1 Miami was the only team to hold its spot in The Associated Press Top 25 on Sunday as idle Ohio State moved up to No. 2 and the poll went through another major reordering in the wake of BYU's loss at UCF and subsequent six-spot fall to No. 8.

stories.title: Baylor fires Aranda day after first loss to KU since 2007
stories.summary: After two straight losses, Baylor has fired football coach Dave Aranda.

stories.title: Sources: Simmons told to leave Chiefs team meeting by Reid, Mahomes
stories.summary: Josh Simmons was kicked out of a team meeting by Chiefs coach Andy Reid and QB Patrick Mahomes, but the OT later apologized, sources told NFL Network.

stories.title: Rodgers now alone with 3rd-most TD passes as Steelers win 1st Paris game
stories.summary: Aaron Rodgers threw one touchdown pass to move alone to third on the career list during the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints as the NFL held its first regular-season game in France.

stories.title: Scheduling nightmare: Dream's Finals venue in doubt for Game 6
stories.summary: With the Valkyries forcing a Game 6 in the WNBA Finals, the Dream are working to resolve a scheduling issue that leaves the venue and time of the game up in the air.
